alerts.headline: Gale Warning issued October 19 at 2:00AM EDT until October 21 at 8:00PM EDT by NWS Boston/Norton MA
alerts.areas: Cape Cod Bay; Nantucket Sound; Vineyard Sound; Buzzards Bay; Rhode Island Sound; Block Island Sound
alerts.description: * WHAT...Northeast winds 20 to 30 kt with gusts up to 35 kt and seas 4 to 7 feet expected. * WHERE...Portions of Massachusetts coastal waters and Rhode Island coastal waters. * WHEN...From 8 PM this evening to 8 PM EDT Wednesday. * IMPACTS...Strong winds will cause hazardous seas which could capsize or damage vessels and reduce visibility.
alerts.instruction: Mariners should alter plans to avoid these hazardous conditions. Remain in port, seek safe harbor, alter course, and/or secure the vessel for hazardous conditions.
